notes.title: One Life - Parkour Project v0.2.2
notes.content:
One Life - Parkour Project v0.2.2 IS OUT NOW!
We're excited to announce the release of our latest update for One Life - Parkour Project! This update brings a host of new features, including:

[b]FreeRoam Mode[/b]: This mode lets you roam freely throughout the game's environment, providing an open playground for your parkour adventures.

You can opt to tackle different routes, each equipped with a timer and, of course, strategically placed checkpoints to challenge yourself in various ways.

Also, it offers an opportunity to earn FLOW POINTS as you perform impressive parkour moves and complete challenges.
These FLOW POINTS can be used to customize your athlete character, adding a personal touch to your parkour experience.

Try it in the Main Menu (Free-Roam Mode).

[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b]: We've also made a number of bug fixes and improvements to the game.

We would like to apologize for the long wait for this update. We know that some of you have been eagerly anticipating it, and we appreciate your patience. We've been working hard to make sure that this update is as good as it can be, and we hope that you enjoy it.

We would also like to thank all of our players for their support. We're grateful for your feedback and suggestions, and we're always looking for ways to improve the game. Please let us know if you have any feedback on this update.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/0V7nMNs/OL-Copertina-Nuova.png[/img]

notes.title: 📢 New Update Alert - One Life Parkour Project (v0.2.0) 🚀
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/7RPVRj1/Alpha0-2-Info.png[/img]

[b]📢 New Update - One Life Parkour Project (Early Access | Alpha 0.2.0) 🚀[/b]

Greetings, Parkour Enthusiasts!

We're excited to announce the release of Alpha 0.2.0, and it's jam-packed with improvements, bug fixes, and exciting features to enhance your parkour experience!

What's New:

[b]FREE-ROAM MODE (Work in Progress)[/b]: Get ready for the ultimate parkour freedom! While this feature is still in development and will be fully available in version 0.2.2, we're giving you a sneak peek of what's to come.

[b]Shop Update[/b]: Discover fresh items and gear in the shop, so you can look and feel even cooler while defying gravity.

[b]New Animations[/b]: We've added a set of slick new animations to make your parkour moves even more stylish.

[b]Fixed Animation Delays[/b]: Say goodbye to those annoying animation delays that used to break your flow.

[b]Fixed UI[/b]: We've cleaned up and improved the user interface for a smoother gaming experience.

[b]Fixed Character's Hat Detaching[/b]: No more hat mishaps while you're mid-air!

[b]Fixed Overriding Obstacles[/b]: Your character will now smoothly navigate obstacles without unexpected hiccups.

[b]New Climbing System (Work in Progress)[/b]: We've added an exciting climbing system to elevate your parkour adventures. Stay tuned for more details in future updates.

[b]Graphic and General Optimization[/b]: We've worked hard to optimize the game, so it runs even better on your setup.

[b]New Ragdoll System[/b]: For those epic fails, we've added a new ragdoll system that promises some hilarious moments.

We're grateful for your continued support, and we're especially thrilled to announce that in [b]Patch 0.2.2[/b], we'll be unveiling the much-anticipated [b]FREE-ROAM MODE![/b] This feature is set to take your parkour adventures to new heights.

Thank you for being part of our parkour journey. Stay tuned, stay agile, and keep defying gravity!

[b]Loyalty Interactive Inc.[/b]

notes.title: One Life - Parkour Project AVAILABLE NOW!
